notes.title: Choose your nightmare – difficulty levels in Shadowless
notes.content:
[h1]🩸 Choose your nightmare 🩸[/h1][p]In [b]Shadowless[/b], you won't just be walking through darkness—you'll decide how deep you want to go.
You can now choose from three unique difficulty levels:[/p][list][*][p]👶 [b]Mom, hold my hand[/b]
For those who want to experience the story and explore the world of Shadowless without major obstacles.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]😶 [b]Things get worse[/b]
Recommended choice. Horror that gradually escalates and reality that cracks under pressure.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]💀 [b]Darkness f***s you[/b]
Your mind will be tested to the brink of insanity. Only for the brave who are not afraid of the last light going out.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whichever path you choose, [b]darkness will follow you.[/b]
The question is: [i][b]will you survive it?[/b][/i][/p]
